meta.source: Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education), via MoSPI eSankhyiki
meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. Each survey year is a cross-section; the five years (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index.
meta.coverage: States/UTs and All India; pupil-teacher ratio (students per teacher) by institution type (all institutions, universities and colleges, universities and their own units) and by mode (regular and distance students together, or regular students only), five survey years.
meta.note: Survey years are fiscal (Apr–Mar), plotted at April of the first year. The five AISHE rounds served by the eSankhyiki API (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index. GER (Gross Enrolment Ratio) = enrolled students ÷ the college-age population × 100; it is gross, so it can exceed 100. GPI (Gender Parity Index) = female GER ÷ male GER; 1.0 is parity. Distance-learning students are counted in the 'regular and distance' ratio, so it runs above the regular-only ratio wherever open universities enrol many students.
